distance_type: Euclidean straight-line distance from representative point to nearest mapped facility geometry
limitations: No road-network route distance or travel time is estimated.
No road condition, seasonality, transport mode, service capacity, prices or opening-hour constraints are represented.
A mapped facility's existence does not prove that it is operational or accessible to every farmer.
Small-holding polygons are represented by an interior representative point; this is not a farm entrance or household location.
ZAAP/ZAPB layer is not semantically disambiguated and is reported under the combined source-layer label.
The nearest-neighbour result measures geometric proximity only.
